scope.summary: Implement the print pipeline exposing its full, grouped, enumerable option surface as StudioExportRecipe executions: General (pages/spreads, copies, collation, layers-to-print); Setup (paper size/orientation, scale with constrain, fit-to-page, position on media, thumbnails, tiling); Marks & Bleed (crop/bleed/registration marks, color bars, page-information marks, offset and weight, bleed values, include-slug); Output (composite leave-unchanged/gray/RGB/CMYK vs separations vs in-RIP separations, text-as-black, trapping mode, flip/negative, per-ink screening frequency/angle, ink-manager access); Graphics (image data all/optimized/proxy/none, font-download policy, PostScript level); Color Management (printer profile + rendering intent); Advanced (flattener preset, OPI omission); Summary (full settings listing). Print presets save complete print states as named exportable/importable presets. Print-as-bitmap (rasterize at a chosen resolution) for non-PostScript devices, and device-independent/device-specific PostScript + per-page EPS creation MUST be supported. Color math owned by 14.8.
acceptance_criteria: full grouped print option surface + presets + print-as-bitmap + PostScript/EPS, all as quiet recipes
proof_targets: headless print-recipe runtime; preset + bitmap/PostScript/EPS test
expected_tests: live: print recipe runs headlessly through all option groups producing output; print preset save/load round-trip
test: print-as-bitmap at chosen resolution + PostScript (device-indep/specific) + per-page EPS

risk_if_missed: No print output; the core publishing deliverable is missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
